name: Futotta Otoko ga Shoujo ni Hanashikakeru Jian Hassei
original_name: 太った男が少女に話しかける事案発生
source:
In the evening, two fat men asked the girl on her way to school, but she ignored him.
What's more, the girl ends up reporting him as a suspicious person.
The two men who were questioned about her duties got angry and decided to take revenge on the girl.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ173125.html]DLsite[/url]]
